title: Launch your first bot
description: Create a bot, save its token, and run the example on your computer.
existingTokenHint: The existing token cannot be shown again. If it is lost, reset the token above and use the new one in the command.
setupDescription: Save the token, run the command from the Appercot repository root, and wait for the connection.
tokenWarning: The token is shown only now. It cannot be recovered after closing — issue a new one in the bot settings.
tokenSavedConfirmation: I have saved the token in a secure place
closeWarning: The token is not marked as saved. Closing this window will remove it from the page.
commandHint: Run this from the Appercot repository root. For a standalone SDK project, use the full guide.
saveTokenFirst: Confirm that you have saved the token first.
copyFailed: The browser did not allow clipboard access. Select the value above and copy it manually.

connection.failedDescription: Check your connection and try again. The bot token does not change.
connection.offlineDescription: Run the command above. Checks continue automatically while this step is open.
connection.ready: Now open the chat and send /start. The reply will appear in the message history.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: The SDK sent an invalid request. Check the SDK version and configuration.
errors.FORBIDDEN: The bot is not allowed to perform this action. Check access and roles.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The chat or requested object was not found. Check the identifiers in the bot code.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: The SDK is sending too many requests. Reduce the call rate.
errors.BOT_BLOCKED: The user has blocked the bot in this chat.
errors.INTERNAL: Internal server error. Check the server log.
